visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light-colored hair, glasses, wearing a light grey hoodie and matching sweatpants, walks into a bright, tiled bathroom with a window and a white toilet. He adjusts his pants and prepares to sit down. (2) He sits on the toilet seat and immediately reacts with a shocked facial expression, jumping back up and hopping around while holding his thighs, as colorful geometric stickers and text overlays appear on the screen. (3) The man walks back into the same bathroom, looking more determined. He stands in front of the toilet, takes a deep breath, and begins a series of rhythmic squats and thigh-slapping movements while a 'LOADING' graphic is centered on his chest. (4) He continues the 'pre-heating' exercises with intense focus, slapping his legs repeatedly before slowly lowering himself onto the toilet seat. He grits his teeth and exhibits a strained, shivering expression as a blue cold-face emoji appears over his head.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Your first urination upon waking in winter. [Subtitle]: 冬天起床第一泡尿的你. (2) [Variety]: 好冰喔!. (3) [Subtitle]: After experiencing it last time. [Subtitle]: 有過上次經驗後. (4) [Variety]: LOADING. (5) [Variety]: *心理建設. (6) [Variety]: *預熱.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young male with bleached/light-colored hair and glasses, wearing a oversized grey tracksuit.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A typical home bathroom with white tiled walls and floor. A white toilet is centered, with a small sink to the left and a metal towel rack with various toiletries and towels on the right.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sound of rapid footsteps on a hard floor followed by the rustling of thick clothing. A light, upbeat, and comical electronic background track is present. (2) A sudden, high-pitched scream of 'Woah!' and 'Oh! Oh!' is heard as the person reacts to a physical sensation, accompanied by the sound of scuffling feet. He shouts 'Hao bing o!' with a strained, high-arousal tone. (3) After a short silence and a scene cut, the BGM continues. Rhythmic thumping or slapping sounds are heard—at least six distinct hits—as the person apparently prepares himself. (4) The person exhales sharply and makes a series of short, grunting vocalizations of 'Ah, ah' in rhythm with the slapping sounds, ending with a low, shivering moan as they settle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous relatable skit about the unpleasant sensation of a cold toilet seat during winter and the exaggerated ritual one might perform to mentally and physically prepare for it.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses common 'relatable content' tropes with over-the-top physical comedy to engage viewers.
